title: henckelia puerensis
intro: Henckelia puerensis, commonly known as Pueraria, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Henckelia puerensis include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, such as daidzein and genistein, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
